issues.evidence: Direct calls to the loaded Pdfium 7961 SDK: cjk characters 0..3 return FPDFText_HasUnicodeMapError=1 despite printable fallback scalars. Tracemonkey page 1 character 2603 returns U+000D with mapping_error=1; independent extraction has a copyright glyph. Current library does not propagate this SDK flag.
issues.required: Propagate SDK mapping errors in scan/diff/text-layer routes; preserve visibility of unmapped glyphs; verify native and WASM. Do not treat a printable fallback as proof of a correct Unicode mapping.

issues.evidence: The original font ToUnicode stream defines a broad identity bfrange, then eight overriding bfchar entries, then p/q -> é/ê. PDF.js and pypdf independently return the declared text. Native Pdfium returns ABCU, U+009B, XABpq with mapping_error=0; current library drops U+009B. Existing text-fragment tests only establish SDK stability, not Unicode correctness.
issues.required: Honor declared CMap overrides or provide a verified alternate extraction path; add a full-page Unicode gold assertion.

issues.evidence: Strict inventories differ, but full-page sample inventories are equal after NFKC. The two engines choose presentation forms vs ordinary Arabic scalars.
issues.required: Keep compatibility equivalence separate from literal Unicode equality and reading-order validation.

issues.evidence: Native extraction includes content not included by PDF.js. Freeculture includes printer filenames, timestamps and margin numbers; the cropped fixture places portions of strings outside its view box. Shading-pattern discrepancy still needs visual/source inspection.
issues.required: Define and test both source-content and visible-page extraction scopes; do not silently discard hidden/off-page content to force agreement.

issues.evidence: The independent worker exceeds its configured 512MiB V8 old-space limit and is terminated. The coordinator continues and records resource_limited; no agreement is claimed.
issues.required: Keep process/time/memory limits. Investigate upstream CMap expansion without relaxing limits to hide the failure.
